title: Revisiting Hate Speech Benchmarks: From Data Curation to System Deployment

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the inter-class similarity (via Jensen-Shannon divergence) and cross-dataset generalizability of the proposed neutrally-seeded data versus existing hate speech benchmarks to demonstrate the skewed distribution and semantic overlap caused by keyword-based data collection.

Evaluating the performance of transformer-based models and a novel mixture-of-experts model (HEN-mBERT) in detecting prejudicial, offensive, and hateful language targeting vulnerable groups across diverse socio-political topics, using both textual content and endogenous user signals (timelines, ego networks, and exemplars).
